ocean_mask.meaning: 1 = stable physically valid open-ocean SST display support; 0 = land, sea ice, or unsupported

issue.display_interpolation: Smooth cross-fades are a visual transition between daily fields; they are not additional forecast times.
issue.ensemble_relation: Independent 100-member companion ensemble generated from the same frozen initialization input as the India validation case.

checks: all 100 members present for every lead
finite TP, T2M, Z500, U850, V850, MSLP, SST, and TTR
SST restricted to derived ocean display support

mslp.description: Daily ensemble-mean pressure reduced to mean sea level.
mslp.interpretation: Large pressure systems; exact centres matter mainly at shorter leads.
mslp.label: Mean sea-level pressure

spread.statistic: Population standard deviation across 100 members (ddof=0); spread measures ensemble disagreement, not calibrated confidence.

olr.description: Positive outgoing longwave radiation derived as the negative of top net thermal radiation.
olr.interpretation: Low tropical OLR can indicate deep cloud and convection; it is not an MJO index.
olr.label: Outgoing longwave radiation

spread.statistic: Population standard deviation across 100 members (ddof=0); spread measures ensemble disagreement, not calibrated confidence.

precipitation.description: Ensemble-mean precipitation rate converted to a 24-hour total.
precipitation.interpretation: Rain belts, monsoon organization, and storm-track shifts.
precipitation.label: Daily precipitation

spread.statistic: Population standard deviation across 100 members (ddof=0); spread measures ensemble disagreement, not calibrated confidence.

sst.description: Daily ensemble-mean sea-surface temperature, displayed over ocean only.
sst.interpretation: Slow lower-boundary patterns; anomalies require a matched ocean climate.
sst.label: Sea-surface temperature

spread.statistic: Population standard deviation across 100 members (ddof=0); spread measures ensemble disagreement, not calibrated confidence.

temperature.description: Daily ensemble-mean temperature two metres above the surface.
temperature.interpretation: Persistent warm and cool regions; local values weaken with lead.
temperature.label: 2 m temperature

spread.statistic: Population standard deviation across 100 members (ddof=0); spread measures ensemble disagreement, not calibrated confidence.

wind850.description: Arithmetic ensemble mean of member 850 hPa wind speed; arrows show the ensemble-mean U/V direction.
wind850.interpretation: Monsoon flow, tropical inflow, and lower-tropospheric circulation.
wind850.label: 850 hPa wind speed

spread.statistic: Population standard deviation across 100 members (ddof=0); spread measures ensemble disagreement, not calibrated confidence.

vector.statistic: Arithmetic ensemble-mean eastward and northward wind components; arrows show vector direction while shading shows vector magnitude.

z500.description: Ensemble-mean 500 hPa geopotential converted to decametres.
z500.interpretation: Broad ridges, troughs, blocking, and planetary-wave evolution.
z500.label: 500 hPa geopotential height

spread.statistic: Population standard deviation across 100 members (ddof=0); spread measures ensemble disagreement, not calibrated confidence.
